audioText:
Male. Large man with a thick New Zealander Maori accent. Insightful, Resolved, Taciturn, Sonorous Voice. Deep, Raspy, gravelly voice.

<speak>Neh'kooan homeland believe it or not, same as the Dunir. Mount Dun is the navel of Verra herself. You're standing on sacred ground. </speak>
